# graylog_event_notification (Data Source)

Retrieves a Graylog event notification by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_event_notification" "example" {
  id = "event-notification-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `config_json` (String) JSON object with event notification configuration.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `title` (String)
